These are plans, so no availability offer or region is recorded. use_case_fits.notes: Agility's 2026-09-15 release targets warehousing and logistics workflows: depalletizing, tote handling, kitting and sequencing, palletizing for shipment; general availability is aimed at 'manufacturing, warehouse and distribution operators'.
use_case_fits.limitations: Digit 5 is announced, not shipping (early access H1 2027, general availability by end-2027); specifications are preliminary. Digit 4's deployments are not carried over to this record.

spec_caveats.text: Agility states 'Payload* 23kg/50lbs' with a footnote marker; the footnote text is not on the page. Agility's 2026-09-15 release states 'up to 50 lb. (22.7 kg) loads'; 23 kg is the page's rounding of the same 50 lb. The draft keeps the page value.
Left UNKNOWN: Agility states 'Reach* 2.2m/7.2ft', which is not the schema's single-arm reach. The release says Digit 5 'can reach heights of up to 7.2 feet (2.2 m)', a vertical reach height.
Agility states a '90-minute runtime battery system' (release 2026-09-15). The page marks specifications as preliminary and subject to change.
